track-bg.$description: Solid surface for the segment track.

track-bg-image.$description: Optional image layered over the track surface.

track-backdrop-filter.$description: Complete CSS backdrop filter behind the track.

track-padding.$description: Inset between the track and its segments.

radius.$description: Corner radius of the control track.

item-bg.$description: Resting surface of an unselected segment, matching the track by default.

item-bg-image.$description: Optional image layered over an unselected segment surface.

item-backdrop-filter.$description: Complete CSS backdrop filter behind an unselected segment.

item-fg.$description: Resting ink of an unselected segment, strengthened in contrast-more.

selected-bg.$description: Raised selected surface, lighter than the track in both schemes.

selected-bg-image.$description: Optional image layered over the selected segment.

selected-backdrop-filter.$description: Complete CSS backdrop filter behind the selected segment.

selected-border-color.$description: High-contrast selection boundary when elevation or surface differences are subtle.

track-size-xs.$description: Extra-small track height before density adjustment.

track-size-sm.$description: Small track height before density adjustment.

track-size-md.$description: Medium track height before density adjustment.

padding-inline.$description: Inline padding of a medium or small segment.

padding-inline-xs.$description: Inline padding of an extra-small segment.

gap.$description: Gap between the leading icon and label.

font-size.$description: Text size of medium and small segments.

line-height.$description: Line height of medium and small segments.
